belkin - usb-c to usb 3.0 adapter with c.description: The Belkin 5-inch USB-C to USB Adapter lets you charge your USB-C device as well as sync your photos, music and data to your existing laptop at transfer speeds of 10Gbps. Plus, the cable also supports up to 3 Amps of power output for charging USB-C devices. This USB C cable is made for connecting from a standard USB-A device to a USB-C (also known as USB Type-C) enabled device. You can power and charge USB-C enabled devices and you never have to worry about which way to plug in again. USB-C is a user-friendly reversible connector that allows you to connect your cable to your device in any direction. SuperSpeed USB Compliance means that this cable has been certified by USB-IF to meet all electrical, mechanical, and environmental standards, ensuring a superior user experience. Connect your USB-C enabled devices (Macbook Pro, MacBook Air, iPad Pro, iPad Air, Chromebook Pixel & more) to USB-A devices and peripherals (flash drives, keyboards, mice). The adapter features a reversible USB-C connector with 3A charging output and has transfer speeds up to 10Gbps.
